traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria and explicit requirements in docs/stories/002.0-DEV-ESLINT-CONFIG.story.md are fully implemented and verified by passing tests. The plugin exposes recommended and strict ESLint v9 flat-config presets; these presets are designed and tested to be spread after a base config that registers the plugin. Rule schemas support configurable options and enforce validation with clear error messages. Story path customization and project-type integration (JS, TS, mixed) are implemented and documented in the ESLint 9 setup guide. Jest test runs confirm that all configuration-related tests tied to this story (including REQ-CONFIG-PRESETS, REQ-FLAT-CONFIG, REQ-CUSTOMIZABLE-PATHS, REQ-RULE-OPTIONS, REQ-PROJECT-INTEGRATION, and REQ-CONFIG-VALIDATION) are passing. Optional Implementation Notes (e.g., migration helpers, config generator) are not normative requirements and do not affect completion. Therefore the story is assessed as PASSED.
